name: MANAR | Tennplasco | Plastic Injection Molder & Contract Manufacturer
old_description: We are deeply committed to manufacturing in the USA, supporting American jobs and contributing to the domestic economy. As a 100% employee-owned company since 2016, we build on the rich legacy of founder Gene Nolen, a pioneer in plastic injection molding, empowering our team to invest in customer success.
about:
Manar, Inc. (also operating as Tennplasco) is headquartered in Lafayette, Tennessee. Founded in 1974 by Gene Nolen, a pioneer in plastic injection molding, the company has operated for over 45 years. In 2016, it transitioned to 100% employee ownership, empowering its workforce of approximately 330 employee-owners to invest directly in customer success.

The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding, offering thermoplastic injection molding, gas-assist molding, and scientific molding across horizontal and vertical presses ranging from 55 to 2,300 tons. It operates multiple facilities: one plant certified to ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 with a white room for medical molding, a second plant certified to ISO 13485 and IATF 16949, and two additional plants certified to IATF 16949. Capabilities extend to in-house tool design, seamless tool transfers, prototyping via additive manufacturing/3D printing, automated assembly, and value-added services such as painting, kitting, and packaging. Process validation (IQ, OQ, PQ) supports early-stage projects.

Manar serves a diverse industrial base including medical device, lawn and garden, consumer products, powersports, automotive and transportation, industrial, aerospace, and power and energy sectors. Its customer roster includes long-standing OEMs; the company notes its very first customer remains a client today.

Founded on Gene Nolen's vision to advance plastic injection molding, Manar emphasizes domestic manufacturing, maintaining all production in the USA. The employee-ownership model, adopted in 2016, aligns the team's incentives with customer outcomes, fostering a culture of accountability and long-term partnership.
